HOW IT WORKS: 
You Have a Travel Medical Emergency 
Private JetMD prepares for the unexpected so our clients don't have to. In the event of a 
medical emergency, including sudden illness, injury and even tragic accidents, anywhere 
in the world, Private JetMD provides peace of mind and stress free travel for you, your 
loved ones, and your employees in the unfortunate event of sudden illness, injuries and 
even tragic accidents while away from home. 
You're more than 150 miles from Home 
Dealing with a medical emergency when you are close to home is difficult enough. When 
you are away from home and out of your comfort zone, emergencies can be frightening 
and nerve racking. If you're more than 150 miles from home you can trust Private JetMD 
to get you the emergency medical treatment you need 
You Need Emergency Medical Assistance 
All it takes is a single phone call for immediate access to the nearest Western Trained 
English Speaking Physician, Dentist, or other Medical Practitioner at a Western 
Accredited Hospital or Clinic no matter where you are. Emergency Medical Assistance 
includes medical case management and monitoring, transportation, emergency 
medical evacuation,medically supervised repatriation and more. 
We Fly You Back 
Once a patient has been discharged from the hospital and is past the acute phase of 
treatment for their emergency medical needs, Private JetMD will arrange for the return of 
the patient to their home. Medical supervision is also provided in the event of transfer to 
another Hospital, Medical Facility, Skilled Nursing Facility, or Rehabilitation Center. 
Benefits: 
In addition to providing Emergency Medical Assistance, Private JetMD also provides 
Members with Pre-trip Health and Medical Information Assistance to help you prepare for 
proper protection against potential risks to your health and well-being. This may include 
referrals to local specialists and health care facilities so that you can continue to get 
adequate treatment while away from home. 
Private JetMD also offers Document, Legal, and Communication Assistance to its

A new Palestinian Authority TV music video honors three terrorist prisoners 
serving a combined total of 40 life sentences. They are responsible for several 
terror attacks against Israeli civilians, including at least two suicide bombings 
that killed 35 and wounded 100. 
.ezt 
NN. The music video shows footage of the three 
arch terrorists while a song with the following words is heard: 
"As long as it may last, the prison's doors will not stay shut [forever)... the 
clouds will disappear, and our honor will be restored."

The terrorists honored in the video are: 
Abbas Al-Sayid - serving 35 life sentences for planning two suicide bombings, 
one in 2002 at a Passover dinner, killing 30 Israelis, and another in 2001, killing 
and wounding 100. 
Marwan Barghouti - serving 5 life sentences for planning terror attacks. 
Ahmad Sa'adat - serving 30 years for heading the terrorist organization PFLP. A 
song at a PFLP event also praised him for planning the assassination of Israeli 
Minister of Tourism Rehavam Ze'eviin 2001, but he has not been tried for this 
crime. 
Click to view 
Following Palestinian Media Watch's exposure earlier this month of another 
video that glorified seven terrorists who together killed over 100 Israeli civilians, 
PA TV removed the pictures of those terrorists from the video and has since 
broadcast the new version. 
However, this has not prevented PA TV from broadcasting this new video 
glorifying three of those same terrorists. 
PMW documents the PA's policy of glorifying terrorists as heroes of Palestinian 
society. 
PMW has documented how the PA rewards terrorists by paying them salaries, 
and released 4 reports last year detailing the salary amounts and showing how 
foreign aid funds partly finances them.

Clarifications and corrections: The Duke of York 
PUBLISHED: 00:01, 11 February 2013 I UPDATED: 00:05, 11 February 2013 
Share 
Articles of 7 and 14 May 2012 said that the Duke of York had demanded a private plane, 
travelled in a chauffeur-driven Rolls-Royce and snubbed free accommodation for his official 
Diamond Jubilee visit to India. We now accept that the Duke had no personal involvement in 
the decision to charter the plane, did not travel in a Rolls, and that the British High 
Commissioner's residence was deemed too small for his party on this occasion. We apologise 
to the Duke of York for the misunderstanding. 
If you wish to report an inaccuracy, please write to the Readers' Editor, Daily Mail, 
Northcliffe House, 2 Derry Street, London W13 51T or email correction a (tail\ mail.co.tuk

Sale or exchange is a term used in tax law to refer to a transaction in which value is received, 
triggering a gain or loss for income tax purposes. A sale or exchange is distinguished from 
inheritance, gifts, or other transactions in property which do not result in a calculable gain or loss.

From: Jeffrey Epstein [mailto:jeevacation@gmail.com] 
Sent: Thursday, January 31, 2013 4:43 PM 
To: McCaffrey, Carlyn

Sale or exchange is a term used in tax law to refer to a transaction in which value is received, 
triggering a gain or loss for income tax purposes. A sale or exchange is distinguished from 
inheritance, gifts, or other transactions in property which do not result in a calculable gain or 
loss.

Sale or exchange is a term used in tax law to refer to a transaction in which value is received, 
triggering a gain or loss for income tax purposes. A sale or exchange is distinguished from 
inheritance, gifts, or other transactions in property which do not result in a calculable gain or 
loss.
